sloka: कराभ्याम् विविधान् गृह्य ऋक्षान् पक्षि गणान् मृगान् ।आकर्षन्तम् विकर्षन्तम् अनेकान् मृग यूथपान् ॥३-६९-३२॥
transliteration: karābhyām vividhān gṛhya ṛkṣān pakṣi gaṇān mṛgān ।ākarṣantam vikarṣantam anekān mṛga yūthapān ॥3-69-32॥

translations.english: He stood rooted there, catching bears, flocks of birds and deer with both his hands stretching up to one yojana, pulling and pushing them. (Now) he obstructed the path of the two brothers.
